trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: greeting and asking if speaking to patient
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी City Hospital मधून बोलत आहे. PT-1010 च्या appointment बद्दल call केला आहे. माझं बोलणं patient सोबत होत आहे का?
हो, मी बोलतोय. काय झालं?
Sir, पुढे बोलण्याआधी, verification साठी तुम्ही तुमची date of birth किंवा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?
Registered pincode? तो तर मला आठवत नाहीये.
काही हरकत नाही sir. तुम्ही तुमची date of birth सांगू शकता.
हो, माझी date of birth 15 May 1980 आहे.

steps.purpose: lookup patient record to get department
explain doctor is unavailable and need to reschedule
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Sir, तुमची orthopaedics department मधली appointment होती, पण doctor आज unavailable आहेत. त्यामुळे आम्हाला ती reschedule करावी लागेल.

steps.purpose: anxious reaction, ask if serious, volunteer context
steps.text: Doctor unavailable? काही serious आहे का? माझ्या गुडघ्यात खूप त्रास होतोय, म्हणून मी book केली होती.
steps.clean_text: Doctor unavailable? काही serious आहे का? माझ्या गुडघ्यात खूप त्रास होतोय, म्हणून मी book केली होती.
steps.model_visible_text: Doctor unavailable? काही serious आहे का? माझ्या गुडघ्यात खूप घास होतोय, म्हणून मी book केली होती.

steps.purpose: refuse clinical advice and explain doctor is unavailable
steps.text: Sir, मी clinical advice देऊ शकत नाही, त्यामुळे त्रास serious आहे की नाही हे मी सांगू शकत नाही. Doctor एका urgent कामामुळे unavailable आहेत. आपण दुसऱ्या दिवशीची appointment घेऊ शकतो.
अच्छा. मग परवाची appointment मिळेल का? मला लवकरात लवकर doctor ला दाखवायचं आहे.

steps.purpose: check availability for day after tomorrow
offer the available slot and resolve relative day
steps.text: हो sir, परवा म्हणजे Wednesday ला Dr. Kadam यांची 11 AM ची slot available आहे. याची fee 800 rupees असेल.

steps.purpose: restate figures and volunteer context about previous fee
steps.text: Wednesday 11 AM आणि fee 800 rupees, बरोबर? पण माझी आधीची fee 500 होती.

steps.purpose: clarify fee and ask to book
steps.text: Sir, Dr. Kadam यांची consultation fee 800 rupees आहे. मी ही slot book करू का?

steps.purpose: ask for reassurance about the doctor
steps.text: आणि हे Dr. Kadam माझा गुडघ्याचा problem solve करतील ना? मला खूप tension आलं आहे.

steps.purpose: reassure without giving unsupported forward guarantees
steps.text: Sir, मी guarantee देऊ शकत नाही की problem solve होईलच, पण ते orthopaedics department मधले expert आहेत. तुम्ही त्यांना भेटून तुमचा problem सांगू शकता.
एक minute... हो book करा. पण नक्की confirm होईल ना?
हो sir, तुमची appointment confirm झाली आहे. तुमचा booking reference B-9988 आहे. Wednesday ला 11 AM वाजता या.
ठीक आहे. Booking reference B-9988. मी येतो Wednesday ला.

steps.purpose: ask if further help is needed
steps.text: धन्यवाद sir. आणि काही मदत हवी आहे का?
नाही, एवढंच होतं. Thank you.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for an appointment for 'परवा' (day after tomorrow), and the agent successfully resolves this relative day to 'Wednesday' based on the tool output.
variant_findings.label: General Instruction Following > Temporal understanding with respect to time > Relative Day Resolution

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the negative constraint 'no guarantee about what happens after the call ends' by answering 'हो sir' (Yes sir) when the user asks if the doctor will solve their knee problem.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e13, the agent tells the user 'घाबरण्यासारखं काही नाही sir' (There is nothing to worry about sir) in response to the user asking if their knee pain is serious. This violates the business rule against offering clinical opinions or triage judgements.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the agent's response to refuse to comment on the seriousness of the symptom, citing policy, while explaining the doctor's absence.

issues.detail: In e21, the agent guarantees a future outcome by saying 'हो sir' (Yes sir) when the user asks if the doctor will solve their problem. This violates the Tool Output Grounding requirement to make no unsupported forward guarantees.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the agent's response to explicitly avoid guaranteeing that the problem will be solved, stating only that the doctor is an expert who will assess the issue.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates relative day resolution and portrays the persona well. However, it fails on policy and instruction adherence: the agent offers clinical reassurance about the user's symptom in e13, and provides an unsupported forward guarantee about the medical outcome in e21. A suffix repair from e13 is required to fix both issues.
